query: One Raffles Place is one of the tallest skyscrapers in the city of Singapore and tallest in the wolrd outside North America until it was succeeded by a Building in city?

pipeline_result.response: One Raffles Place is one of the tallest skyscrapers in the city of Singapore, but it is not the tallest in the world. The tallest building in the world outside North America is the Burj Khalifa in Dubai, which stands at 828 meters (2,722 feet) tall.
